text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E after large gains felt rewarding, but I should avoid trimming just for the satisfaction of locking in gains; base decisions on its outlook and portfolio balance.","I added to Stock B at higher prices, so I should reassess the investment case and position size before averaging up rather than letting recent gains drive trades.","Frequent account checks can encourage unnecessary trading; I should use clear rules for buying, selling, and holding, and keep risk and diversification in view."]}
